mission: 一次整体实施任务，通过依赖节点持续执行，状态与工件持久化。

tasks.goal: 读取用户新需求和源稿，确认岗位、两模式、建筑/实施决策优先。
tasks.definition_of_done: 不引入旧版价格中心、人月排期或逐字段审批。

tasks.goal: 核对上游代码与许可，建立可复用文件清单，先跑原有可运行测试。
tasks.definition_of_done: 保留精确ref/blob与声明；不能把无密钥、未运行或预设Demo记作通过。
tasks.implementation_note: Exact selected source refs/blobs/licenses recorded; DSH baseline passes. Full original CRE suite historical optional-dependency failure remains separately recorded; migrated parser tests pass.

tasks.goal: 建立单一Canonical schema源，生成TS/Pydantic类型与存储迁移。
tasks.definition_of_done: 不同语言序列化往返通过；scope/来源/时间/unknown/规则作用域完整。
tasks.implementation_note: Canonical schema, generated TS/Pydantic, PostgreSQL storage, semantic round trip and canonical hash verified.

tasks.goal: 移植CRE界面/解析接口，接入DSH作为单一运行时。
tasks.definition_of_done: 禁用原内置控制器；读/写/委派工具范围受控；可显示真实run事件。
tasks.implementation_note: CRE selected workbench and DSH single runtime integrated, including actual live agents and SSE.

tasks.goal: 移植HIRE/RETQA/GeoAgent/STORM等指定模块并封装统一工具。
tasks.definition_of_done: 真正调用迁入逻辑；不重复实现搜索/解析；只读SQL/错误/超时测试通过。
tasks.implementation_note: Specified bounded ports called through capabilities; scoped rows/SQL, retrieval, source merge, GIS and public research verified. Optional large upstream systems not imported merely for naming.

tasks.goal: 创建内部材料与经验编译流程，支持事实、组织约束、偏好和线索。
tasks.definition_of_done: 权限与project作用域保留；不把建议变法规；材料提示注入不扩权。
tasks.implementation_note: Real model Context compilation plus project-authority normalization; local data policy, formats, source locators, rule revoke and version checks implemented.

tasks.goal: 建立独立合成数据生成器、gold与变形测试。
tasks.definition_of_done: 输入无答案；明确synthetic；unknown保持未知；真实资料不得被合成值覆盖。
tasks.implementation_note: Independent synthetic inputs/gold retained; invariance, unknown, conflict and source-boundary tests run.

tasks.goal: 研究分工→候选→工具校验→反证→比较→行动包。
tasks.definition_of_done: 有限预算；支持条件化/并列；不按Agent数量投票；日志追到工件。
tasks.implementation_note: Actual professional research, candidate generation, independent critic and six-dimensional comparison completed via DSH.

tasks.goal: 打通自动/企业两模式，并实现Context变化的局部重评与版本diff。
tasks.definition_of_done: 不整体拆除等组织条件改变相关路径；只读无关证据不重新抓取。
tasks.implementation_note: Automatic/enterprise modes and current-input comparison verified; unchanged metrics, binding project constraint and unaffected evidence reuse.

tasks.goal: 执行离线闭环、恢复、权限隔离、冲突/缺项/失效与对照测试。
tasks.definition_of_done: 测试日志可复现；fixture运行不得冒称真实模型推理；跳过项单列。
tasks.implementation_note: 97 automated tests and bounded actual model/isolation/recovery cases passed; validation scope explicit in the evidence record.

tasks.goal: 在授权环境验证模型、原生搜索和一处真实公开材料。
tasks.definition_of_done: 使用真实返回/时间/版本；失败或缺凭据明确blocked，不伪造证据。
tasks.implementation_note: User-configured key; real model and native search succeed. Hangzhou public case includes four government full texts and one explicit metadata-only source.

tasks.goal: 整理复现、许可证、配置、演示和完成状态，核对申报口径。
tasks.definition_of_done: live未通时允许仅交离线包但明确状态；不将原研、业务效果或企业试点写成已实现。
tasks.implementation_note: Runnable source, lockfiles, launchers, current docs/proposal, evidence/screenshots and credential-free source release prepared.

tasks.goal: 整理首批可追溯公开语料，建立来源归集、去重分组、待标注候选、用途记录和本地监督样本导出。
tasks.definition_of_done: 原文能回读；同源资料不能跨集合；模型输出和回归 gold 不进入监督训练；未标注及无用途凭证的行不能导出；通过针对性检查。
tasks.implementation_note: 6 public sources, 5 with text, 17 chunks/unlabeled candidates; 10 fixtures and 8 model records kept as regression metadata. 17 corpus tests pass; collection/search/export exercised locally. No weight training.

tasks.goal: 持续积累获得允许用途的脱敏项目资料、专家修订理由与决策结果，形成经核对的任务标签。
tasks.definition_of_done: 训练来源用途可追溯；标签有实际核对者与原文依据；同项目和同源修订保持同组；事后结果与决策时点输入分离；独立最终评估集另行确定。
tasks.implementation_note: 资料重点和标注步骤已登记在 data/corpus/README.md；当前批准训练行数为 0，不宣称模型训练就绪。

tasks.goal: 按用户修正将界面改为高德原生 3D 地图入口，支持缩放、倾斜、地点点选浮卡、明确进入详情、卫星/楼块图层及返回地图。
tasks.definition_of_done: 真实高德配置与数据接通；默认不展示完整研判；点选先浮卡后详情；研究面板关闭保持地图；实际 3D 楼块、影像与小屏流程可复现；安全密钥不返回客户端；地图坐标不混标。
tasks.implementation_note: Native Windows hardware WebGL displays AMap buildings and imagery; real POI and reverse-geocoding flows verified. Current map tests 10 pass, full baseline suite 124 pass, latest build passes. Software rendering gets explicit 2D fallback.

tasks.goal: 首次选中展示真实资料，地图专题标色与项目数据关联；实际模型引用来源，建立私有 GitHub 库。
tasks.definition_of_done: 真实数据关联和来源可查，范围不随拖图变化，合成与内部数据边界保持；真实地图和模型联调、必要回归通过；仓库推送验证。
tasks.implementation_note: 143 checks and build pass in a clean staged-source snapshot. Actual AMap and model integration, public project source citations, frozen map scope, cancellation, mobile/desktop and private GitHub commit readback verified.

tasks.goal: 极简对象研判、GIS分区、DSH短摘要skill与50个来源案例
tasks.definition_of_done: 规则、来源隔离与按需调用通过回归；PR CI通过；真实地图与模型凭据联调单独验收。
tasks.implementation_note: Local: 92 JS tests, 10 geometry tests, 8 offline full-app browser checks and build pass. New live-provider acceptance not run.

tasks.definition_of_done: 真实网关调用成功；低置信、缺项与阻点处理清楚；来源约束、简报修复、调查项与真实应用链路通过验证；密钥只在本机。

tasks.goal: 公开记录Adapter、对象参与路径、六维仪表盘、真实流式进度、标色修复与浙大校区研读。
